scope:
Audit half-row CPU, cold boot and complete disk playback against resident AY.

Keeps deterministic frame/copy/parser costs separate from elapsed Fuse
delivery. Full CPU pixels and sampled Fuse pixels have different coverage.

startup_and_playback_timing.includes: all elapsed CPU/ROM/disk/IRQ/ULA time from PLAYER entry to finished; excludes BASIC loading PLAYER and human disk changes

timing_gates.disk_latency_note: Fuse call intervals combine ROM execution, physical emulation, IRQs and contention; no artificial separation

irq.scope: Read-only physical field/IRQ correlation. Nearest listing row is only a locator, not a ROM disassembly.

note: CPU delta covers frame stages and the extra map-copy parser instructions. It excludes changed ZX0, queue/copy, AY scheduling, ULA, ROM and disk costs. Fuse covers their combined delivery effect. Video data roundtrip exactly; only map granularity changes.
